description.advanced-settings: Decklists, player list, place and time, seats, round length, check-in and scoring — with defaults that follow the format.
description.already-joined: You are already registered for this tournament.
description.claim-qr: Let {{name}} scan this code to take over the seat on their own device, with or without an account.
description.confirm-cancel-tournament: The tournament will be cancelled and cannot be reopened.
description.confirm-drop-awaiting_one: {{count}} player never checked in and will be removed:
description.confirm-drop-awaiting_other: {{count}} players never checked in and will be removed:
description.confirm-remove-player: {{name}} will be permanently removed from the tournament.
description.confirm-start-tournament: Format, table size and scoring are fixed afterwards.
description.deckbuilding-running: Deckbuilding is running — no tables, just the clock.
description.decklist-policy-optional: A decklist is welcome but not required to play.
description.decklist-policy-required-check-in: Must be on file before check-in — registering without one is still fine.
description.decklist-required-check-in: Hand it in before you check in.
description.decklist-required-register: A decklist is required to join.
description.format-kind-constructed: Everyone brings a deck built for one of the supported formats.
description.format-kind-limited: Decks are built on site from booster packs — Draft or Sealed.
description.guest-unclaimed: Your entry is not linked to an account yet. Sign in to claim it.
description.join-as-guest: No account needed — just a name for the pairings list.
description.join-by-code: Enter the code the organizer showed you.
description.join-qr: Scan it, or type the code in by hand at {{origin}}/join.
description.no-pairings: Create the pairings and the tables appear here.
description.no-pairings-player: The organizers have not paired this round yet.
description.no-rounds: Add the first round. For draft and sealed, start with the draft or deckbuilding stage — those do not count as rounds.
description.no-rounds-player: The organizers have not started a round yet.
description.no-standings: Once the first round has results, the table appears here.
description.outstanding-tables_one: {{count}} table has no result yet — places can still move.
description.outstanding-tables_other: {{count}} tables have no result yet — places can still move.
description.participant-audience-anyone: Visible through the share link as well.
description.participant-audience-organizers: Players see only their own entry.
description.participant-audience-participants: Everyone registered sees the whole field.
description.round-minutes: The default for each round's clock.
description.scan-to-join: Scan, or enter the code at {{origin}}/join
description.scoring: The default follows the table: 7 / 1 / 0 at a pod of four (2n−1 per the Multiplayer Addendum), 3 / 1 / 0 one on one. Enter 5 / 1 / 0 for a Topdeck-style event, say.
description.settings-locked: The tournament is running — structure and scoring are frozen.
description.share-link: Anyone holding the link sees the tournament, and the player list if you opened it to anyone.
description.share-link-dead: The organizers withdrew or replaced it.
description.tiebreak-floor: Every opponent rate has a floor — somebody who lost everything still counts as a third of a win for the people who played them. Without it a weak field would be punished far too hard.
description.tiebreak-gw: Share of the game points this player could have taken.
description.tiebreak-mw: Share of the points this player could have taken.
description.tiebreak-ogw: Mean of every opponent's game-win rate.
description.tiebreak-omw: Mean of every opponent's match-win rate.
description.tiebreak-opp-points: Average match points of the opponents.
description.tiebreak-points: Win, draw and loss at this event's own values.
description.venue-instructions: Shown to everyone who can see the tournament.
description.visibility-private: Only the organizers can see the tournament.
description.visibility-unlisted: Anyone with the link can see it, nobody else.
